title: Person
description: A person represented by a record, referenced by links to that record, with editable account identity associations. Not an authentication or access-control assertion.

name.description: Collection-owned display name, not a verified account name.

identities.description: Editable identity associations. Missing or empty means this person has no linked account. Match issuer and subject exactly; never match by email or name.

issuer.description: Stable issuer URL supplied by the identity service. Copy exactly; do not derive from a collection authority or relay URL.

subject.description: Opaque, case-sensitive, account-wide identifier supplied by the issuer. Not an email, membership ID, or credential.
